user_story: As a user, I want to input numeric values into a numeric input field so that I can provide valid data for processing. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The numeric input field is available on the page identified by the selector 'input[type="number"]'. 2. When a valid numeric value is entered, no error message is displayed, and the user remains on the same page. 3. If an invalid value (like a string) is entered, the input should not accept it, and the user should remain on the same page without any URL change.
